transformToUVY.method: PROVISIONAL MainShell-local gravity-constrained similarity P2 (REJECTED): gravity from 1426 plumb lines; yaw from the observed plaza-side 1F curtain-wall direction vs MainShell plaza 1F glazing (heading 13.85 deg, U45-63); position from the observed facade corner (plaza 1F glazing plane ∩ U+ high-glazing plane) -> MainShell corner (63.3,-35.3); scale from plaza 1F glazing mullion pitch (observed 2.04 model units vs MainShell 2.60); vertical datum from observed glazing base -> Y=0
transformToUVY.formula: ENU = scale * rotation * X_sfm + translation (X_sfm = sparse/0 world coords); Unity = (ENU.x, ENU.z, ENU.y); UVY: U = x*sin16.2 + z*cos16.2, V = x*cos16.2 - z*sin16.2, Y = y. Equivalently UVY = M*X_sfm + m with M,m below (det M < 0 because UVY is a reflected frame).
transformToUVY.hypothesisEnvelope: alternative scale 1.13-1.37x and yaw +-1.5 deg about the corner (spread of local scale indicators) moves Z3 points by up to 1.4-2.5 u and corridor/elevator points by up to 4-5 u (per-component envelopeU in observations.json)

reason: No metric registration of the U+ end reaches class-a. (1) The only overlap with the March-registered corridor is one planar sign (타는 곳 ← / 표 사는 곳) on the right approach wall seen from two frames on the escalator (B_000/B_001); it fixes position but not yaw/scale, and the blurred landing turn that links it to the corridor is unstable between reconstructions (up to 9 median camera steps). (2) The MainShell-local provisional fit (P2) leaves the held-out March controls 3.6 u away, the landing low ceiling at 2.90 vs 2.25, and the U+ corner-segment facade outside tolerance (median 0.10 u, 28% within 0.05 u, direction 1.15 deg, mullion pitch +13%). The local scale indicators disagree over a 1.13-1.37x range, so the scale is not established.
limits: Positions in observations.json use the rejected provisional P2 transform and are topology/placement estimates with the stated per-component envelope; they are not construction dimensions.
MainShell 1F glazing grid is a source-model schematic (no door gaps modelled at U45-63, while imagery shows automatic doors under a yellow 5 sign); pitch-based scale may not be as-built.
Model-internal geometry (planarity, reprojection, held-out views) is good: all component track reprojection RMS <=1.01 px, held-out median <=0.81 px (1920x1080).
No survey scale; source-model units only.
Clip A (26-27.75 s, upper escalator descent) is not joined; the 2F elevator lobby (41.4-44.6 s) was not used.
